title: Frames & Stories Writeup

steps.text: Story: Sam is a photographer and the police have found out that he is trying to convey some sensitive information through his portfolio website. Help them find out what it is.

Solution: https://photographic.domectf.in/  is a website and with so many images in it.
 There is a puzzle file which will be in the path  https://photographic.domectf.in/puzzle/puzzle.txt  and the hint is given in the robots.txt.
 Puzzle.txt file contains:
             #!AES-CBC

         IV   =   ?
         KEY   =   boq33vPAIYbtj
         PLAINTEXT   =   ?
         CIPHER   =   c5  ............
